$comment: Project mode (src/project.js, scripts/project.mjs): one storyboard per product. Phases run left to right; each screen is a real capture (data/ path), its earlier takes, the component it belongs to, the code paths that draw it (per repo id from work.config.json; ref = the branch to read) and the words that tie your asks and board refs to it. next = prototype links [screen, trigger]. critic = the critic-loop verdict for the screen (works|rough|broken, issues, fix); frame = [w,h] of a screen frame (default 16:10); title names the storyboard when it is one app inside the product. scene = the film beat in data/mission.json whose state/note is the screen's status.

critic.source: vision critic over a scripted walk of http://127.0.0.1:8852 at 582504d; stages 12–13 checked against DOM

screens.name: First open
next: pulls the sheet up: the library, grouped

critic.did: Opens the link. Nothing chosen, nothing playing.
critic.goal: Explain the map in one glance and offer one obvious first move.
issues: No hint what a dot is or what to tap; idle player reads "Sound Atlas · 1,815 free CC tracks" with 0:00 / –:––
Header meta (here now · visits · Motion) competes with the brand before anything is playing
critic.fix: One-line coach mark on the ring ("each dot is a free song · tap one") that dies after the first play; a "Play something" shuffle on the idle play button

screens.name: Browse the library
next: taps sort: emotions, key, tempo, tonalit

critic.did: Pulls the sheet up: the library, grouped by feel.
critic.goal: Show the catalogue grouped by feel, scannable.
issues: Row meta truncates mid-word ("House & Dance · K…")
Group header packs count · bpm range with no labels
critic.fix: Let row meta wrap to two lines at half sheet; label the bpm range

screens.name: Change the sort
next: picks key: map, list and colours re-file

critic.did: Taps Sort: emotions, key, tempo, tonality, density, soundstage.
critic.goal: Re-file everything by a different lens, with plain explanations.
issues: "Camelot wheel" is DJ jargon for a beginner
critic.fix: Say "Key — songs that mix smoothly together" first, Camelot second

screens.name: Atlas re-sorted by key
next: taps the first filter chip on the rail

critic.did: Picks Key: map, list and colours re-file by key.
critic.goal: Map, list and colours re-file by key.
issues: Ring labels become bare numbers 1–12 plus "UNMEASURED"; key name only shows in the list
Chip row shows bare numbers
critic.fix: Label ring wedges "1A Ab min" at zoom 0; rename UNMEASURED to "key not measured yet"

screens.name: Filter by a chip
next: types 'rainy night piano'; ai semantic s

critic.did: Taps the first filter chip on the rail.
critic.goal: A chip tap should show its result.
issues: Tapping a chip at peek keeps the sheet down: 2 matching tracks exist but the list stays hidden
The chip reads "1" with a tiny count; no clear-filter affordance besides re-tapping
critic.fix: Chip tap at peek raises the sheet to half and shows "Key 1A · 2 tracks ×"

screens.name: Search a vibe
next: taps a dot on the map: song plays, map f

critic.did: Types 'rainy night piano'; AI semantic search ranks the catalogue.
critic.goal: Semantic search ranks 108 tracks for "rainy night piano".
issues: Toast "No new CC0 / CC BY songs on Openverse for that" fires while 108 good matches are on screen: reads as a failed search
Results grouped by the current sort (key) instead of by relevance
critic.fix: Silence the Openverse miss when local hits exist (or say "108 matches here · nothing new on Openverse" inline at the list foot); group search results by match strength

screens.name: Tap a dot: it plays
next: pulls up the sheet on track: lineage, me

critic.did: Taps a dot on the map: song plays, map flies to it.
critic.goal: Tap a dot: it plays and the map flies to it.
issues: Playing dot is labelled, but at peek nothing says the sheet holds its details
critic.fix: Nudge the Track tab once on first play

screens.name: Track details
next: scrolls to the meters: tempo, key, brigh

critic.did: Pulls up the sheet on Track: lineage, meters, credit.
issues: "Family" vs "Style" unclear to non-musicians

screens.name: Listening profile (meters)
next: scrolls to layers: map zooms all the way

critic.did: Scrolls to the meters: tempo, key, brightness, busyness, soundstage.
critic.goal: Listening profile: tempo, key, tonality, separation, soundstage, density, dynamics.
issues: Meter detail lines ("side/mid 0.57 · L/R 0.51", "crest 16.8 dB") are engineer-only
"Drag a meter" instruction is small grey text
critic.fix: Hide the numbers behind a tap (expert drawer); make "Drag a meter to find a song that sounds like that" the section title

screens.name: Layers: map zooms into the stems
next: solos the first stem; master mutes, only

critic.did: Scrolls to Layers: map zooms all the way in, stems ring the dot.
critic.goal: Scrolling to Layers zooms the map all the way into the playing dot; stems ring it.
issues: Stem labels on the canvas are tiny; ring colour ↔ lane colour pairing not obvious
⇄ has no word
critic.fix: Draw each lane's colour chip beside its name on both halves; label ⇄ "borrow"

screens.name: Solo a stem
next: taps ⇄ on drums: a similar song lends it

critic.did: Solos the first stem; master mutes, only that layer plays.
critic.goal: Solo drums: master mutes, drums ring lights, toast "Only drums".
issues: Other lanes show M lit, which reads as 3 mutes rather than one solo
critic.fix: While soloed, show "Solo: Drums · Full mix" in the Layers header instead of lighting the other Ms

screens.name: Borrow a layer (remix)
next: drags brightness: now-playing jumps to t

critic.did: Taps ⇄ on drums: a similar song lends its drums, tempo-matched.
critic.goal: Borrow a similar song's drums, tempo-matched.
issues: After Full mix + ⇄, the map zooms back out to the whole atlas while the Layers pane is still on screen (layerK 1 → 0): the two halves disagree
Lane reads "from Itty Bitty 8 Bit" but nothing says it is tempo-stretched or how to give it back
critic.fix: Keep layerK at 1 while .layers intersects the sheet viewport; lane subtitle "drums from Itty Bitty 8 Bit · stretched 96→100 bpm · tap ⇄ to return"

screens.name: Tune: drag a meter to steer

critic.did: Drags Brightness: now-playing jumps to the closest-measuring song.
critic.goal: Drag Brightness: now-playing jumps to the closest-measuring song (Aerosol of my Love → Envision).
issues: Only the toast says the song changed; no "was Aerosol of my Love" and the "Next closest" list is below the fold
Percentile arrows ("11th → 0th pct") are dense
critic.fix: Pin a one-line "Steered from Aerosol of my Love · undo" under the player during a tune; scroll Next closest into view on release

screens.name: Similar (by ear)
next: picks the song (♥), opens community: who

critic.did: Opens Similar: 40 sound-alikes with the reason each matched.
critic.goal: 40 sound-alikes, each with the reason it matched; seed stays on top.
issues: Reason line is the most useful text but is the smallest
critic.fix: Promote "same synth lead + plucked synth" to row subtitle size

screens.name: Community, radio, playlists
next: starts by-ear radio: endless, each next

critic.did: Picks the song (♥), opens Community: who's here, radio, publish picks.
critic.goal: Who is here, radio, publish picks as a playlist.
issues: "1 here now" and "1 listening" repeat each other when you are alone
Like count "1" under the heart is tiny and ambiguous (yours or everyone's?)
critic.fix: Alone: say "Just you right now · 59 visits"; label the heart count "1 like"

screens.name: By-ear radio
next: same app at 1440 px: sheet becomes a sid

critic.did: Starts by-ear radio: endless, each next song sounds like the last.
critic.goal: By-ear radio: endless, each next song sounds like the last.
issues: Radio state is only a tinted icon + a 2.4 s toast; Community tab stays selected
Next-up song is never shown
critic.fix: A persistent "● By-ear radio · next: <title>" line in the player while radio runs

critic.did: Same app at 1440 px: sheet becomes a side panel.
critic.goal: Same app at 1440 px: side panel.
issues: Shared link opens paused with no play cue on the map
Filter chip row runs under the panel ("Tense" clipped)
Meters cut off at the panel foot
critic.fix: Clip-free chip row (wrap or scroll inside the map column); autoplay-on-gesture hint on the selected dot
